exposure: Impacted fetal head during emergency caesarean section
outcome: Feasibility of a randomized controlled trial (RCT)
cohort: The study involved healthcare professionals, pregnant women, women who had a second-stage caesarean, and parents.
finding: A randomized controlled trial comparing the fetal pillow with the vaginal push technique for managing an impacted fetal head during emergency caesarean section was found to be feasible and widely supported by healthcare professionals.
